categories.main_business_segments: Henan Xinning Modern Logistics Co., Ltd. primarily operates in integrated supply chain logistics services focusing on bonded warehousing for electronic components, providing warehousing management, distribution, freight forwarding, customs clearance, smart supply chain, IoT and Beidou positioning services. The company serves mainly the 3C electronics industry and is expanding into new energy vehicles and fast-moving consumer goods supply chains. It also offers international freight services including multimodal transport and cross-border logistics solutions. Additionally, it develops and integrates logistics software and intelligent warehouse systems.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced technologies such as 5G, AI, IoT, Beidou satellite positioning, and intelligent warehouse automation including AS/RS, AGV, automated labeling, and WMS/WCS/TMS systems. It develops proprietary logistics management software platforms and smart supply chain solutions, focusing on digital transformation and intelligent logistics equipment integration. The company emphasizes continuous R&D in smart warehousing, digital logistics, and cloud-based platforms to enhance operational efficiency and service quality.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are manufacturing enterprises in the 3C electronics sector, including brands like Lenovo, Motorola, Compal, Huaqin, and Asus. The company also serves clients in the new energy vehicle industry, fast-moving consumer goods, tobacco, and public sectors such as municipal sanitation and emergency services. Its markets cover domestic regions with a focus on East China, Central China, South China, and Southwest China, and it is expanding international operations in Southeast Asia and beyond.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates extensively across China with major logistics hubs and operations in Kunshan, Suzhou, Shanghai, Wuhan, Chengdu, Chongqing, Shenzhen, Nanchang, Foshan, and Zhengzhou. It has established international subsidiaries and operations in Singapore, Vietnam, and Hong Kong, supporting cross-border logistics and global supply chain services. The geographic coverage includes key domestic industrial regions and international trade corridors.
categories.supply_chain_position: Henan Xinning Modern Logistics functions primarily as a third-party logistics provider positioned midstream in the supply chain, offering integrated warehousing, distribution, freight forwarding, customs clearance, and supply chain management services. It acts as a logistics service integrator supporting upstream suppliers and downstream manufacturers and distributors, with capabilities extending to international logistics and cross-border supply chain solutions.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic priorities include expanding new business areas such as new energy vehicle supply chains and international logistics, enhancing service quality through refined management and cost control, and accelerating intelligent and digital transformation. R&D focuses on smart warehousing systems, digital logistics platforms, IoT and Beidou positioning technologies, AI-driven logistics automation, and cloud-based supply chain solutions. It aims to strengthen technology innovation, develop proprietary software, and promote intelligent logistics equipment integration to maintain competitive advantage.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through service fees from integrated supply chain logistics services including warehousing, distribution, freight forwarding, customs clearance, and value-added logistics services. Additional revenue streams include sales of logistics equipment and software products, international freight services, and satellite positioning and IoT-based monitoring services. The company operates mainly on a direct sales model with contracts and service agreements with manufacturing and industrial clients.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a significant player in the integrated supply chain logistics sector for the 3C electronics industry in China, with strong brand recognition and competitive advantages in intelligent warehousing and digital logistics solutions. It competes with other third-party logistics providers specializing in electronics and manufacturing supply chains. Its focus on technology-driven logistics and expansion into new energy vehicle supply chains positions it competitively in emerging logistics markets.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 480.7 million, a 16.44% increase year-over-year, with a net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB -72.76 million, reflecting a significant reduction in losses compared to the previous year. The company’s total assets stood at RMB 567.4 million with equity attributable to shareholders at RMB 200.9 million. Despite ongoing losses, the company is improving operational efficiency and expanding revenue, supported by capital injections and strategic business development.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Henan Xinning Modern Logistics emphasizes its nearly 30 years of experience in integrated supply chain logistics, offering customized, high-quality, and technology-enabled logistics solutions tailored to the 3C electronics and emerging industries like new energy vehicles. Its proprietary smart logistics systems, intelligent warehouse automation, and comprehensive supply chain services provide clients with enhanced efficiency, cost reduction, and improved service quality. The company’s commitment to digital transformation and international expansion further differentiates it as a technology-driven, customer-centric logistics partner.
